case: Kinder Morgan Energy Partners, L.P. / Kinder Morgan, Inc. (2014)

claude.performance_metric: no divestiture; single C-corp (KMI) formed, ~$140bn pro forma enterprise value
claude.rationale: Section 2 documents that the pipeline/transportation product (T4) and its operating processes (T5) were already jointly controlled by KMI and carried forward unchanged, so product and processes moved together (gap_45=0); likewise operations (T5) and the organization/people (T6, already unified under KMI, no separate KMP employees) were coherently aligned at closing (gap_56=0). Section 4 states no P4 product-process disruption and no P5 process-organization fracture manifested, since operations and organization were already unified pre-consolidation (p4_pathway=0, p5_pathway=0). The change was to the legal vehicle (LP->C-corp, T3 swap) and value-flow model (pass-through MLP->C-corp, T2 swap) by design, with controlling intent continuing (KMI controlled KMP before and after).
